newsitem.title: UK: Airtours, Carnival have Costa majority.
newsitem.headline: Airtours, Carnival have Costa majority.

text.p: British holiday company Airtours Plc and its U.S. partner Carnival Corp hold a majority stake of Italian cruise operator Costa Crociere SpA, Credit Suisse First Boston said on Thursday.
Airtours and Carnival launched their joint 168 million stg bid for the Italian group last month.

CSFB, on behalf of Airtours and Carnival, said the companies now held 79.3 percent of the Italian company's ordinary shares, 45.6 percent of the saving shares and 11.2 percent of saving warrants -- equivalent to 53.7 percent of the full diluted capital.
CSFB said Costa's board had recommended its shareholders to accept the bid.
A CSFB spokeswoman later said for the offer to become unconditional 90 percent of the ordinary shares and 75 percent of the fully diluted capital need to be tendered by June 6.
In Italian tender offers significant amounts are normally tendered on the closing two days.
